subject: general
question: Which of the following quadratic equations has one of its roots as 2 + sqrt5?
solution:
**Given:**

One root of the quadratic equation as 2 + sqrt5 

**Concept used:**

Whenever, one root of the quadratic equation is given as

a+ sqrt b , then other root will be a - sqrt b 

**Calculation:**

One root of the equation is 2 + sqrt5 

So, the next root will be 2 - sqrt 5&l
